embeds.title: 🔴 Mistral AI SDK, TanStack Router hit in npm software supply chain attack
embeds.description:
**Actor:** TeamPCP
TeamPCP threat group compromised 170 npm and PyPI packages across multiple ecosystems including TanStack Router (42 packages), @squawk (87 packages), @uipath (66 packages), @tallyui (30 packages), @beproduct (18 packages), Mistral AI's SDK suite, and Guardrails AI PyPI package on May 11. The attack exploited GitHub Actions pull_request_target trigger to inject Mini Shai-Hulud malware, which steals developer credentials and installs a destructive dead man's switch that deletes the user's home directory if a stolen GitHub token is revoked.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🟢 3 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** GitHub Actions pull_request_target trigger exploitation to scrape maintainer OIDC tokens
**Incident date:** 2026-05-11 • **Confidence:** claim
